purpose: Freeze the discovery indicator-family adjudication instructions together with the row-level role field required by exact-hash import.
role_boundary: Future citation, attention, diffusion, disruption, acceptance, publication, or model-performance outcomes are excluded from the T0 discovery indicator-family set. Opportunity and control variables may be retained only with their role stated in adjudication_notes.
family_rule: Every include row has one nonblank canonical_family_label; every exclude row has a blank canonical_family_label. Labels are normalized consistently across every supplied discovery round without a target count.
provenance_rule: For artifacts governed by this composite protocol, row-level independent_ai_prompt_sha256 and manifest prompt_sha256 must equal the SHA-256 of this JSON file.
